scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @flashlab/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && npm run build -w @flashlab/shared && npm run build -w @flashlab/frontend && npm run build -w @flashlab/backend
scripts.test: npm run build -w @flashlab/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:services: npm run build -w @flashlab/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @flashlab/backend" "npm run dev -w @flashlab/frontend"
